description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Fire)

Benefit: As long as you have an elemental (fire) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, you can spend a standard action to create a 5-foot-radius burst of fire at a range of 30 feet. This burst deals 1d6 points of fire damage per level of the highest level fire spell you can cast. A successful Reflex save halves the damage. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (fire) spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Fire)
